name: ToDo995 Gameplay/UI positive envoy API and save/load diagnostic

steps.code: MapConfiguration.SetValue('MAP_SCRIPT','Continents.lua');assert(MapConfiguration.GetValue('MAP_SCRIPT')=='Continents.lua','official map script not selected');GameConfiguration.SetValue('GAMEMODE_HEROES',true);local v=GameConfiguration.GetValue('GAMEMODE_HEROES');assert(v==true or v==1,'Heroes & Legends not enabled');return 'GAMEMODE_HEROES=1'

condition.code: return Game.GetLocalPlayer()>=0 and Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]:IsTurnActive() and ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption~=nil and ExposedMembers.JAC_AbsorptionFlow~=nil

steps.code:
local from,to
for _,player in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMinors()) do from=player:GetID();break end
for _,player in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do
  if player:IsHuman() then to=player:GetID();break end
end
assert(from and to,'one minor and one human major required')
local recipient=Players[from]:GetInfluence()
local sender=Players[to]:GetInfluence()
assert(type(recipient.GetTokensReceived)=='function','Gameplay GetTokensReceived unavailable')
assert(type(sender.GiveFreeTokenToPlayer)=='function','official influence grant unavailable')
local before=recipient:GetTokensReceived(to)
assert(type(before)=='number' and before>=0,'invalid starting envoy count')
sender:GiveFreeTokenToPlayer(from)
local after=recipient:GetTokensReceived(to)
assert(after==before+1,'official envoy grant did not increment recipient count once')
Game:SetProperty('JAC_ADMISSION_ENVOY_PROBE_V1',{From=from,To=to,Before=before,After=after})
return 'Gameplay positive envoy count verified: '..tostring(before)..' -> '..tostring(after)

local t=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ADMISSION_ENVOY_PROBE_V1'))
assert(Players[t.From]:GetInfluence():GetTokensReceived(t.To)==t.After,'UI and Gameplay envoy counts differ')
return 'UI recipient envoy count agrees with game-core'
